Study a chess position, then rebuild it from memory [...] Hi Product Hunt! I'm Bing, the solo developer behind Memory Chess. We launched here about a year ago and placed 5th. Since then the game has grown from about 100 to about 1,800 players a month, and many of the changes in 2.0 started as a sentence in the feedback box. What's new: • A daily board. Everyone gets the same position once a day, with one try and its own leaderboard. Monday is gentle, it gets harder through the week, and Sunday is one big board. • A skill rating that moves both ways. The old one only went up, so everyone drifted to the top. Now each board has a difficulty, and your rating is the board you rebuild about 70% correctly. • A dashboard with your memory span, accuracy trend, the squares you miss most and your streak.
